scope_reviewed: The partial pre-outage laravel-api lane: MDSR-01, MDSR-03, MDSR-09, MDSR-12, MDSR-17 and MDSR-26-php. merge_meta.json unreviewed_impls_before_outage has no laravel-api-D7 entry, so the changed set comes from git and the coordinator's attribution in reports/laravel.md:282. Diffing f4f223414 against the working tree shows these lane changes under poly_apps/laravel_main: app/Services/DataSync/{DataSyncProtocol,DataSyncService,DataSyncStateStore,DataSyncPeerClient,DataSyncSessionRuntime,DataSyncPassiveService,DataSyncDriverService,ResourceSyncService}.php, app/Http/Controllers/Dashboard/DataSyncController.php and app/Http/EnvironmentApiInfo/CommonApiInfo.php. The working tree equals HEAD for all of them (committed in 5bbb23682/b20962b4f). The DataSync hunks between 74e7770 and f4f223414 come from the earlier, already-reviewed laravel-T1/T3/T4/T6 work. The CommonApiInfo.php -8 header hunk is a header-cleaner removal (D18) and is ignored. app/Utils/SystemArchiveManager.php did not need to change, because extract7z already takes a target directory. The other items of this task (MDSR-18, MDSR-24, MDSR-07, AHSC-35-relay, CKA-27) have not started and stay in pycore-laravel-G3.

MDSR-03.detail: The peer cancel moved from the driver into DataSyncSessionRuntime::finish (DataSyncSessionRuntime.php:83-101). finish() copies the job before the terminal save compacts it (:86 $activeJob, :95 save), then calls cancelPeer($activeJob) for every non-completed end (:97-99). cancelPeer (:108-123) runs only for driver roles with a peer_session_id and peer_token, and skips the call when the last observed peer status is already terminal. So the cancel (DataSyncDriverService.php:75-78), failure (:115-116) and keepalive-failure (:126-130) paths each send exactly one token-authenticated POST, and so do the service-level protocol-mismatch end and the withLock cancel. DataSyncPeerClient has no constructor, so the new runtime dependency creates no DI cycle. Verified in-process (see checks).

MDSR-01.detail: assertNoConflictingLocalSession (DataSyncPassiveService.php:625-637) now blocks on every driver role plus the other passive role, all read from the contract. prepare() (:36-49) still supersedes idle sessions of either passive role before this check. Verified in-process: with an active local 'source' session, export-prepare and prepare both raise 'This node already has an active synchronization session.' (409 through DataSyncController.php:339-340), and the session count stays the same.

MDSR-09.status: confirmed (round 2: 'a terminal save deletes it' now passes on Windows after the B1 fix; see resolved_issues)
MDSR-09.detail: exportArchive (DataSyncPassiveService.php:124-146) stores the path list as the artifact 'archive-paths-<key>' and keeps only {pending, artifact} in context.pending_archives. It records only once per key. buildRequestedArtifacts (:468-475) reads the artifact, builds the archive and forgets the artifact. A terminal save calls DataSyncArtifactStore::forgetSession (DataSyncStateStore.php:89-93). Verified in-process: an exportArchive with 50,000 paths answers busy, the session JSON is 2,778 bytes, and the artifact holds all 50,000 paths. On this Windows node the terminal-save deletion cannot succeed, because FileSystemManager::delete is POSIX-only.

MDSR-12.detail: DataSyncProtocol::DEFAULT_PORT is gone. defaultPort() (DataSyncProtocol.php:73-77) resolves service_contract.json data_sync.default_port_ref ('ports.laravel_api_backend'). This is the same contract port that ServiceContract::port('laravel_api_backend') returns, reached through the contract's own reference, which the UI also reads. The only caller is DataSyncPeerClient.php:37-39 (normalizeAddress), and the health response is DataSyncService.php:151. A grep for 9000 in app/Services/DataSync and the controller finds nothing. Verified in-process: '1.2.3.4' gives http://1.2.3.4:9000, '::1' gives http://[::1]:9000, and 'https://h' gives https://h:443.

MDSR-17.status: confirmed for archives up to ARCHIVE_MAX_FILES; the manifest-less fallback is a recorded gap (non_blocking)
MDSR-17.detail: completeArchive (ResourceSyncService.php:311-359) verifies the archive hash and extracts into incoming/<id>/archives/<key>.extract. Each staged file moves into the live root only when its SHA-256 matches the plan manifest. A file that is unplanned or mismatched, and a planned file the archive lacks, is skipped. The skipped list is stored in the completion receipt, so a replay returns the same result. The manifest comes from the plan item (DataSyncDriverService.php:646-648, :934-937). Pull passes it inline (:874-883). Push sends it with the chunk that carries the last bytes (:898-902), and the receiver keeps it as an artifact until its timer extracts the archive (DataSyncPassiveService.php:271-276, :476-486). Skipped paths feed skipResources, so verifyResources excludes them and transferred_files discounts them (DataSyncDriverService.php:920-925). The controller validates the manifest (DataSyncController.php:237, :356). Laravel's validator keeps keys that contain '.' or '*', and non-string values become '' and count as a mismatch. Verified in-process with a real 7z (4 files: 2 good, 1 tampered, 1 unplanned; plus 1 planned file that was never shipped): files=2. The two good files land with matching hashes. The tampered and unplanned files never reach the live root. The skipped list is exactly [extra, tampered, missing], and a replay returns already_present with the same list.

MDSR-26-php.detail: The version, active/terminal statuses, driver/passive/writer roles and terminal_retention come from service_contract.json#data_sync through ServiceContract::positiveInt/stringList (DataSyncProtocol.php:28-71). All callers use the methods (StateStore :20, :25, :74, :178-206, :302-317; Service; Passive; Driver; Runtime). The writer_roles list replaces the ['receiver','fetcher'] literal at DataSyncStateStore.php:25. The index adds terminal_retention (DataSyncController.php:37). CommonApiInfo.php:169, :205 and :209 document it and read version(). No reference to the removed constants remains in app/, routes/, config/, bootstrap/ or tests/. Verified in-process: every reader equals the contract, and DataSyncController::index returns protocol_version 5 and terminal_retention 5.

MDSR-18, MDSR-24, MDSR-07, AHSC-35-relay.detail: No code_revision in DataSyncService::health. English step details remain (e.g. DataSyncDriverService.php:201, :242, :294, :416, :566, :689, :707, :709). DatabaseSyncService, DatabaseManagerService, RelayContract, StaticServer and ServerManagerV1 have only header-cleaner hunks. These items stay in pycore-laravel-G3 and are not re-listed as blocking.

resolved_issues: Round 2 (pycore-lead re-review, 2026-09-27 21:15): B1 resolved by laravel-api-D7-fix (verdict reviews/laravel-api-D7-fix.json approved). FileSystemManager::delete() branches to a junction-safe native delete on Windows (:610-612, deleteNative :643-664, removeNativeEntry :666-676; landed in 0b6f362e3), and the POSIX sudo path is unchanged. The in-process scratch run passed 42/42. A terminal save removes the session's artifacts, receipts, incoming, archives, plans and cancel/activity locks (MDSR-09). pruneTerminal evicts back-dated scratch sessions beyond retention 5 (MDSR-26-php). completeArchive removes its .extract staging and .7z.part (MDSR-17). The 4 real sessions are byte-identical. The lane files are unchanged since round 1 (last commit 5bbb23682, clean working tree). Original round-1 entry: Windows compatibility: poly_apps/laravel_main/app/Utils/FileSystemManager.php:602-636 delete() removes paths only through shell_exec('sudo -u <user> rm [-rf] ...') (:629, :632) and has no Windows branch. On Windows (no sudo) it returns false and leaves the path; the in-process probe confirmed this on this node. Every DataSync cleanup that the reviewed items rely on is therefore a no-op on the D8 local Windows Laravel, where the MDSR-19 pull acceptance will run. Affected: DataSyncArtifactStore::forgetSession (DataSyncArtifactStore.php:73-78), so the MDSR-09 stated check 'a terminal save deletes it' fails; DataSyncStateStore::delete/pruneTerminal (DataSyncStateStore.php:51-62, :296-319), so terminal_retention=5 (MDSR-26-php, used by the MDSR-11 UI) is never enforced; and ResourceSyncService::completeArchive staging and .7z.part cleanup (ResourceSyncService.php:330, :334, :355-356). Staging with the skipped files was observed left behind after a successful archive. Fix (pycore-laravel, which owns app/Utils): when PathMapper::isWindows(), delete natively. Use unlink for files and links (rmdir for directory links and junctions), and a child-first RecursiveDirectoryIterator walk with unlink/rmdir for directories. Return !file_exists(). Keep the POSIX sudo path unchanged. Verify in-process on Windows using scratch paths and scratch session ids only: delete removes a scratch file and a nested scratch directory; a terminal save of a scratch session removes its artifacts/incoming directories; and pruneTerminal removes a scratch terminal session beyond retention. Do not create more than terminal_retention minus the existing terminal sessions (4 exist locally), so no real session is pruned. php -l passes.
non_blocking: MDSR-17 gap, recommended for G3: DataSyncDriverService.php:898 omits the manifest when an archive item has more than ResourceSyncService::ARCHIVE_MAX_FILES (100,000) paths. ResourceSyncService.php:340 then treats a missing manifest as 'trust every extracted file', so on a push a tampered file lands in the live root, and verifyResources (DataSyncDriverService.php:1027-1067) later fails the whole session instead of skipping the file. buildResourcePlan makes one uncapped 7z item per root (:646-649). The fetch side already rejects more than 100,000 paths at POST /resource-archives (DataSyncController.php:293, pre-existing). This is not a regression, and the largest local root is 40,122 files (static). Fix: split '7z' plan items at ARCHIVE_MAX_FILES with an archive id separate from the root key, so every archive carries its manifest and large fetches pass validation. After that, keep the manifest-less path only for a peer that predates this change.

Upgrade window: an exporter prepared before this change stores pending_archives[key] as a plain path list, and protocol_version is still 5. For such an entry, DataSyncPassiveService.php:469-470 resolves artifact '' and DataSyncArtifactStore::require throws InvalidArgumentException out of advance(), outside the try at :360-366. This repeats every tick until the exporter goes idle (PASSIVE_IDLE_SECONDS=3600). Guard with is_array($pending) && isset($pending['artifact']) and otherwise drop the entry; the fetcher's retry records it again.

Variables at the top (AGENTS.md): new locals are declared mid-body at ResourceSyncService.php:340 ($expected) and :345 ($stagedPath), DataSyncPassiveService.php:137 ($artifact), :469 ($pathsArtifact) and :477 ($manifestArtifact), and DataSyncDriverService.php:921 ($skipped). Fold this into the next edit of these files.

FileSystemManager::rename() (FileSystemManager.php:565-586) uses the same sudo cp/rm pattern and also fails on Windows. DataSync does not use it (moveFile renames natively and falls back to replaceFile). It may be fixed together with the blocking item.

ServiceContract::dataSync() (ServiceContract.php:185-193) has no caller, and its docblock names DataSyncProtocol as its reader. This is already recorded in reviews/laravel-D7.json non_blocking for G1 and is not repeated here as a change.

notes: Recommended option taken, without asking. The six landed items are correct and verified, and the lane's diff has no defect of its own. The not-started items stay in pycore-laravel-G3, following the laravel-D7 precedent. I still chose changes_requested, because one stated verification of this task (MDSR-09 'a terminal save deletes it') fails on the D8 local Windows node, and the cause (FileSystemManager::delete is POSIX-only) breaks the Windows/Linux compatibility rule for every DataSync cleanup and for retention. A blocking entry is the only way the fix becomes an assignment. It is small, it is in pycore-laravel's own scope (app/Utils), and it touches no G3 file, so it can run in parallel with G3. After it lands, this verdict can flip to approved with no other change to the lane's files. The MDSR-17 size gap and the upgrade-window guard are recorded as non_blocking inputs for G3, not as changes to this task.
